description: Defines the PlayerBase class, an abstract base class for media players in Android, including method declarations, member variables, and external dependencies.

classes.name: PlayerBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for media player implementations, providing core functionalities and interface for derived classes.

methods.name: PlayerBase
methods.description: Constructor for PlayerBase class.

methods.name: ~PlayerBase
methods.description: Destructor for PlayerBase class.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Pure virtual method to destroy the player instance.

methods.description: Starts playback, overrides IPlayer interface.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback, overrides IPlayer interface.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback, overrides IPlayer interface.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume, overrides IPlayer interface.

methods.description: Sets the pan, overrides IPlayer interface.

methods.name: setStartDelayMs
methods.description: Sets start delay in milliseconds, overrides IPlayer interface.

methods.name: applyVolumeShaper
methods.description: Applies volume shaping configuration and operation, overrides IPlayer interface.

methods.name: startWithStatus
methods.description: Starts playback with device ID, returns status.

methods.name: pauseWithStatus
methods.description: Pauses playback, returns status.

methods.name: stopWithStatus
methods.description: Stops playback, returns status.

methods.name: reportEvent
methods.description: Reports player event with device ID.

methods.name: baseUpdateDeviceId
methods.description: Updates device ID mapping.

methods.name: triggerPortIdUpdate
methods.description: Updates port ID mapping in AudioService.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the player with type, usage, and session ID.

methods.description: Performs cleanup for the player.

methods.name: playerStart
methods.description: Handler for starting the player, can be overridden.

methods.description: Handler for pausing the player, can be overridden.

methods.description: Handler for stopping the player, can be overridden.

methods.name: playerSetVolume
methods.description: Handler for setting volume, can be overridden.
